conditions.text: Set up app version 3.1.0 on Android 15, device Pixel 8 — these were the values reported in all events considered.

The push state in all events was deliverable, with OS permission ALLOWED and provider registration REGISTERED, and the profile was consistent; these were present every time but the packet does not establish that they are required for the crash.
Only 3 events were considered and every step and precondition had full support across them, so the packet identifies nothing that varies and therefore nothing that can be marked as not required.

Two commits touch the crashing file or its neighbours and are leads only, not confirmed causes: c31b222 "MEI-41: Cache job detail responses", which overlaps src/modules/jobs/api.ts and src/modules/jobs/apply.ts, and c31a111 "MEI-40: Apply to jobs from the detail page", which overlaps src/modules/jobs/apply.ts; if you are trying to force the repro, exercising the job-detail caching path is the most direct thing to try.

missing_evidence_questions.text: What does the body of the 200 response to GET /api/jobs/42 actually contain — is the detail field absent, null, or shaped differently than fetchJob expects at line 23?
Is job id 42 specific to these events, or does any job id reproduce it? The packet records only that one call target.
Does the caching introduced by c31b222 store or replay a partial job payload, and does the crash only occur on a cache hit versus a fresh fetch?

Does the crash reproduce outside app 3.1.0 / Android 15 / Pixel 8, or on other push and profile states? With 3 events all sharing these values, the packet cannot separate required conditions from coincidence.
Is there any step between tapping the job card and the detail fetch — for example an apply action touched by c31a111 — that the captured breadcrumbs did not record?

steps_prose.text: Open the jobs list screen at /jobs.
Tap a job card (li.job-card) in the list.

The detail load issues GET /api/jobs/42, which returns HTTP 200; the crash surfaces in fetchJob at src/modules/jobs/api.ts line 23 with "job.detail is null", so the 200 response is reaching code that expects a detail field.

summary.text: Three events show a NullPointerException with the message "job.detail is null", thrown in fetchJob at src/modules/jobs/api.ts:23, and it happens right after opening a job from the jobs list and the detail request GET /api/jobs/42 returns 200.
